# Conte Games Studio

> Independent mobile game studio based in Saint-Chamond, France. Games and apps for iPhone; COCOBOUM!, Les Tableaux Ensorcelés, Mieux Chaque Jour and Caligula vs Gladiators are also on Google Play for Android, other Android versions are on the way. The website is available in 140 languages.

Contact: contegamesstudio@gmail.com

## Games

- [COCOBOUM!](https://contegames.com/en/cocoboum/): Play COCOBOUM!, a free Android / iPhone game: pop bubbles, beat levels, challenge other players in duels and climb the global leaderboard.
- [Royaume des Mots Croisés](https://contegames.com/en/royaumedesmotscroises/): Solve crosswords, earn coins and grow a medieval village in Royaume des Mots Croisés, now available on iPhone.
- [Mieux Chaque Jour](https://contegames.com/en/mieuxchaquejour/): Mieux Chaque Jour: a well-being app with nutrition and yoga to help you make progress every day. Available on iPhone.
- [Les Tableaux Ensorcelés](https://contegames.com/en/tableauxensorceles/): Play Les Tableaux Ensorcelés for free on Android / iPhone and iPad, with no ads. Complete 50 magical puzzles and restore an enchanted castle.
- [Caligula vs Gladiators](https://contegames.com/en/caligulavsgladiators/): Caligula vs Gladiators: face gladiators and wild beasts in the arena, earn stars and coins, and get a thumbs-up from Caligula. Mobile game on iPhone.
- [Sauve qui Flèche ! Casse-tête](https://contegames.com/en/sauvequifleche/): Sauve qui Flèche! (Arrow Escape): get every arrow off the board in the right order through medieval levels full of keys, doors and teleporters. Mobile game on iPhone.
- [Royaume des Énigmes](https://contegames.com/en/royaumedesenigmes/): Royaume des Énigmes (The Kingdom of Riddles): match symbols, solve riddles and defeat 3 bosses across 30 levels, with 6 bonus games and 50 relics to collect. Mobile game on iPhone.
- [Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées](https://contegames.com/en/gnomedescavernes/): Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées: 90 rail puzzles in 6 crystal caverns. Set the switches and guide every cart to the exit of its colour. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
- [Le Château des Lumières](https://contegames.com/en/chateaudeslumieres/): Le Château des Lumières: turn the mirrors and guide the light to the crystals across 150 levels and 6 painted worlds. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
- [Le Petit Dragon](https://contegames.com/en/petitdragon/): Le Petit Dragon: a hand-painted 2D platform game. Cross 7 kingdoms, 63 levels and 7 bosses to drive out the King of Shadows. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
- [Le Tailleur de Nuages](https://contegames.com/en/tailleurdenuages/): Le Tailleur de Nuages: 240 puzzles in 12 sky regions. Cut, rotate and place clouds to open a path. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
- [Les Rouages Enchantés](https://contegames.com/en/rouagesenchantes/): Les Rouages Enchantés: 150 mechanical puzzles in 6 fairy-tale worlds. Place the gears and carry the energy to restart the machines. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
- [Royaume des Runes](https://contegames.com/en/royaumedesrunes/): Royaume des Runes: place the falling rune blocks, group the colours and chain combos across 180 levels and 6 regions. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
- [Serpent des Runes](https://contegames.com/en/serpentdesrunes/): Serpent des Runes: a snake game with a dragon. Eat the runes, avoid the obstacles and beat 6 guardians across 120 levels. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
